fact: Version 1.1 of 27 December 2023 of the ANCS labelling framework requires N-Cloud and G-Cloud providers' main and backup data centres to be located in Tunisia and run by Tunisian-law entities (measure TN-01), with the Agence Nationale de la Cybersécurité awarding the label.
title: Référentiel de labélisation des fournisseurs de services d'informatique en nuage (N-Cloud et G-Cloud)
